mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 48 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The Waning Crescent moon is out, and we are expecting an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona encourages residents to stay informed through their digital newsletter, which covers vital programs and projects. Additionally, the Public Works Department is managing routine maintenance and recently announced upcoming asphalt repairs for November 9 and 10.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Thursday is a big night with ART House 360 events and trivia at Hop Haus, while the weekend brings live music to Bailey's Run, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market on Saturday.
In our weekly look at police activity, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man who had been stationary at an intersection for 20 minutes and subsequently arrested him for O W I.

Today's flavor was Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Since Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night, look forward to tomorrow's flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, when the store opens again at 10:00 AM.
